title: On Courant-like bound for Neumann domain count
summary: In this work we show that in general there is no Courant-like bound for Neumann domain count. In order to do that we construct a sequence of domains $Ω^n$ such that the first Dirichlet eigenfunction for $Ω^n$ has at least $n$ Neumann domains. Also a special case of convex domains is considered and sufficient conditions for existence of Courant-like bound for small eigenvalues are found.
